# REQ-AUD-18 AC2 — coverage exclusions for the auditor's Python (.github/agent/bin/), mirroring
# the Go gate's .github/policy/coverage-exclusions.txt. Checked by
# .github/agent/tests/coverage-check.py.
#
# One range per line:  <path>:<first>-<last>  <one-line reason>
# A range must exclude at least one unexecuted statement and NO executed one (the gate fails a
# stale or over-wide range). Only code that genuinely needs Anthropic's endpoint or a real
# GitHub token / API may be excluded; everything else is tested. "An exclusion that hides
# testable code" is on the review loop's merge-blocker list.
#
# Measured scope: .github/agent/bin/ minus .github/agent/bin/tests/ (the tests themselves).
# fixtures/ holds test inputs, doubles and vendored PyYAML — test code, not auditor code.
